mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.09%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.09%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a tight labor market with accelerating inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE decline and CPIAUCSL rise) occurs but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (e.g., INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), manufacturing output contraction leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Higher CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 142,000 thousand persons) signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 142000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a stagflationary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (GDPC1 decline and CPIAUCSL rise) occurs but SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, rising retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS is rising.
